subject: Augmentation & isolation schedule / SLA review
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@brightwell.ai>
To: Elliot Price <elliot_price@redwood.ai>
Cc: Leah Ortiz <leah.ortiz@brightwell.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal window coming up — request to add isolated on-prem cluster

Hi Elliot,

Quick note as we start the renewal conversation for Brightwell AI (contract: BW-2024-09). We hit our internal compliance checkpoint and need to add a physically isolated on-prem cluster (air-gapped network + customer-managed HSM) for PII processing. Ideally we want the cluster stood up and capacity reserved at the start of the next term (proposed effective 2027-07-01).

High-level asks: 
- New isolated cluster (3x A100-equivalent nodes) in our DC in Austin
- Dedicated VPC connectivity and KMS/HSM integration
- 24-month term (we're open to discount for commit)
- SLA for cluster availability (target <250ms p95 for inference)

Can you confirm feasibility and a rough cost/lead time? Also we'll attach a short redline doc with some legal asks. Looping in Leah for infra specifics.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Patel
Head of ML Infrastructure, Brightwell AI
From: Elliot Price <elliot_price@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@brightwell.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal window coming up — request to add isolated on-prem cluster

Samir — thanks for the heads up. This is doable but there are a few moving parts (on-prem provisioning, HSM/KMS integration, and SLA commitments for isolated clusters).

Next steps I recommend:
1) Marissa: draft an SOW with the proposed cluster sizing + timeline.
2) Ben: provide pricing bands for 12 vs 24 month commits (with burst capacity options).
3) I'll loop in Neha for the compliance and encryption checklist so we can pre-clear requirements.

Can you share the redline doc and any network diagrams for Austin? If you have a preferred start-of-term date we can align provisioning windows and capacity reservation.

I'll get an internal timeline together once Marissa shares the SOW.

—Elliot
Elliot Price
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@brightwell.ai>, Elliot Price <elliot_price@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: SOW draft: isolated on-prem cluster (Austin) — draft attached

Hi Samir / Elliot,

Attached is a first-pass SOW (Brightwell_Augmentation_SOW_v3.pdf) with: scope, acceptance criteria, provisional timeline (provisioning start: 2027-06-10; go-live target: 2027-07-01), and runbook handoff items. Key callouts:
- Hardware: 3x A100-equivalent nodes (redundant control plane)
- Network: dedicated vLAN + customer-managed transit (we list options for VPN or private peering)
- Security: support for HSM-backed key wrapping; audit log forwarding to customer SIEM
- Ops: 2-week dry-run prior to cutover; runbook review with Brightwell infra team

Questions for you:
- Is the proposed provisioning window OK?
- Any special compliance docs we should include in the SOW?

We can iterate quickly on redlines.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Leah Ortiz <leah.ortiz@brightwell.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Elliot Price <elliot_price@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@brightwell.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 10:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOW draft: isolated on-prem cluster (Austin) — draft attached

Marissa — thanks for the draft. Attached are our redlines (Brightwell_redlines_v1.docx). A few highlights: 
- We need explicit language confirming no shared tenant access to the isolated cluster and that Redwood will not access customer data without explicit request.
- HSM integration: requirement for customer-managed keys (BYOK) and an annual key rotation process.
- SLA: target p95 inference latency of <250ms is acceptable, but we need clarifications for scheduled maintenance windows and credit calculations.
- Timeline: Austin provisioning looks tight. Can we pad the provision start to 2027-06-20 to allow for hardware lead times?

Attaching network diagram and a short list of compliance artifacts we need.

On Thu, Apr 22, 2027 at 09:45 AM Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai> wrote:
> 
> Thanks again — adding more detail to SOW per our call.
> 
> —Marissa

Thanks,
Leah Ortiz
VP Infrastructure, Brightwell AI
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Leah Ortiz <leah.ortiz@brightwell.ai>, Samir Patel <samir@brightwell.ai>
Cc: Elliot Price <elliot_price@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Pricing options and term structures for isolated on-prem cluster

Leah / Samir — putting pricing on the table so you can decide. Attached is an options spreadsheet (Pricing_Options_24-12-table.xlsx). TL;DR: 
- 12-month term (baseline): list price for nodes + ops = $1,200,000/year (no commit discount).
- 24-month term (preferred): 18% discount applied to hardware/ops line with a 10% discounted rate for 2x burst credits prepaid.
- SLA: Standard SLO for private clusters (99.9% uptime). For tighter latency SLOs (p95 <250ms) we include a premium + dedicated engineering runbook and higher monitoring retention.

Notes:
1) We can commit to the 2027-07-01 go-live if hardware lead times are handled by 2027-06-20 (matching your ask).
2) Neha is copied to accelerate the compliance artifact exchange — she'll provide the encryption checklist and SOC2 attestation copies.

If that looks good I can kick off a revised SOW + term sheet and send the DocuSign link for signatures.

Regards,
Ben Carter
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Elliot Price <elliot_price@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@brightwell.ai>
Cc: Leah Ortiz <leah.ortiz@brightwell.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing options and term structures for isolated on-prem cluster

Samir — locking next steps: 
1) Brightwell confirms whether you want to proceed with 24-month term (Ben's recommended path).
2) If yes, Ben will send the revised SOW + term sheet and DocuSign link; target sign by 2027-06-01 to meet provisioning timeline.
3) Neha to run the compliance artifact exchange (SOC2, encryption checklist) once we have a signed SOW.
4) Marissa to schedule a provisioning kickoff for the week of 2027-06-21.

If Brightwell confirms 24 months we'll include the latency-focused monitoring runbook and the dedicated escalation path in the SOW. Please let us know final decision by EOD 2027-05-27 so we can secure hardware slots.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

—Elliot
Elliot Price
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
